name: Putting It All Together
instructions: Thirty days in, you should be able to hold several open chords, strum in time, and play at least one full song -- real, usable guitar skills.
Set your next goal now: a new song, a barre chord, or a new strumming pattern, so momentum carries past this program.
Consistency beats intensity -- even 10-15 minutes a day will keep you improving from here.
Revisit today's opening video as a close to the program -- the fundamentals it covers are what everything else was built on.
